entities.name: Nađa Ninković

entities.summary: Nađa Ninković is a professional volleyball player from Serbia, who was a member of the Serbia women's national volleyball team that won the gold medal at the 2011 European Championship in Serbia and Italy. She plays for CSM Volei Alba Blaj.
